body.condition: For every \(i\in[n]\) and \(t\in\mathbb T\), \(|r_{\theta i}'(t)|\ge a_0\operatorname{dist}_{\mathbb T}(t,Z_{\theta i})^m\), with the same constant \(a_0\) for every node and model.

novel.justification: This is a uniform finite-type rate condition, not a consequence of quantitative Morse theory. The periodic family \(r_i(t)=b_i\gamma_m(t)-\log Z_i\), with \(\gamma_1(t)=1-\cos t\) and \(\gamma_m(t)=\sin(t)^{m+1}/(m+1)\) for \(m\ge2\), has separated zeros of order at most \(m\), including zeros of exact order \(m\), and satisfies the displayed margin for constants fixed by \(b_i\).
